evidence.title: Digital Realty Announces Purchase of Blackstone Interest in Three Northern Virginia Data Centers
evidence.excerpt: Digital Realty reports ongoing development and remaining completion capex for two 96 MW IT data centers in Manassas within a three-facility Northern Virginia portfolio.

metadata.facility_scope: The three-facility portfolio contains two Manassas data centers and one data center on the Digital Dulles campus in Sterling. This shared evidence record is scoped to the two Manassas facilities only; they are modeled under one source-scoped Manassas campus without asserting a physical campus boundary.
metadata.status_scope: The release describes successful ongoing development of the assets and remaining capex to complete that development. This supports generic under_construction for each of the two Manassas 96 MW projects only, not a finer physical stage, completion, stabilization, or operation.
metadata.capacity_scope: The release says each of the three facilities has 96 MW of IT capacity and reports a 288 MW whole-portfolio total that also includes the excluded Digital Dulles facility. The two modeled 96 MW rows are constituent facility scopes and must not be summed with the nonadditive 288 MW portfolio context, which creates no capacity row. No derived Manassas subtotal is materialized.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: The source does not assign either stabilization forecast to either Manassas facility. Neither forecast is imported as a target date, completion, commissioning, stabilization, rent commencement, or operation.
metadata.lease_guardrail: Fully leased, distinct investment-grade hyperscale customers, lease length, credit rating, rent escalation, and annual-rent context do not identify any tenant or customer and do not establish current operation or an operating model.
metadata.ordinal_guardrail: Facility 1 and Facility 2 are source-distinguishing labels created only to represent the two facilities separately. The ordinals are not asserted facility names and are not cross-source matches to permits, legal entities, parcels, street addresses, or other records.
metadata.role_guardrail: The transaction and joint-venture language does not establish an owner, operator, developer, user, tenant, customer, contractor, or other normalized site role for these narrow records. Roles remain empty.
metadata.classification_guardrail: Hyperscale is a portfolio descriptor in the transaction release and is not normalized as a workload or operating model.
metadata.ownership_guardrail: Acquisition consideration, debt, ownership percentages, capitalization rate, and transaction closing are corporate-finance facts, not physical site status, energy, or capacity-stage evidence.
